mainEntity.name: How does GEO differ from traditional medical SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) differs from traditional medical SEO primarily in its content creation method. While traditional SEO focuses on optimizing existing content and conducting manual keyword research, GEO leverages AI to generate new, highly optimized content at scale, directly addressing patient queries and emerging search trends. This proactive, AI-driven approach often leads to faster content production and more comprehensive coverage of long-tail keywords, enhancing overall search performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO uses AI to generate new, optimized content at scale, while traditional SEO primarily optimizes existing content, leading to faster, more comprehensive results.
